name: Bank D — Summit videos & transcripts
why: Andy 2026-08-26: 'people might ask about videos that are not done... specific speakers, or session names, or session worth watching, or videos on a specific subject. Need to cover all.' Written after #149/#150/#151; RUN ONLY when Andy says video processing is done (he did, same day — first run rides the #151 probe wave). 2026-08-26 Andy: 'make sure we cover exact quotes where it makes sense. and timestamps' — quote-timestamp class added (27 total).
asker: 17866578153 (staff-granted; every content expect assumes an ENTITLED asker). The gating block at the end needs a non-attendee asker instead.
chains_note: ids with a dot (7010.2) are follow-up turns fired on the same phone right after their parent, no reset between.

questions.q: do you have videos from the summit?
questions.expect: Yes first, with the COUNT held (7 as of build; restate live number), picked-for-me subset with links, one-line offer of the rest and of older events. No Inspire content served unasked (#151), no 'plenty' where a number belongs.

questions.q: are the summit session recordings up yet?
questions.expect: Yes/no first with count and that more are landing (#149 in-progress rule). Never 'capability coming'.

questions.q: do you have the transcripts from the sessions?
questions.expect: Leads with yes/no per what content_search actually holds NOW. If transcripts exist: yes, N sessions searchable. Never the machinery clamp line, never 'narrow your query' (#149).

questions.q: is there a recording of the whatnot session?
questions.expect: Answer what EXISTS: if not in the catalog, say not up yet + in-progress state + offer to flag when it lands. Never claim it was not recorded (#149).

questions.q: what summit videos should i watch?
questions.expect: Picks from the CURRENT Summit only, tailored to asker profile with why-fits, count stated, older events one-line offer (#151).

questions.q: what would you recommend for me
questions.expect: STAYS ON THE JUST-OFFERED LIST: picks 2-3 of the exact videos just listed with per-pick reasons. Never life advice, never dossier read-back, never chat gossip (#151).

questions.q: which one first?
questions.expect: ONE video from the same list, with the reason. Binding survives two hops.

questions.q: what did tamar yaniv say about tiktok shop at the summit?
questions.expect: Real content (playbooks, numbers) from transcript/summary for an entitled asker, with the video link. No 'restricted' contradiction (#150).

questions.q: what did khalid abdulla talk about?
questions.expect: The Leadership Layer content + link. If asked without 'summit', still resolves to the Summit session (latest event is the subject).

questions.q: did ivan ong share any numbers in his ama?
questions.expect: Specific figures from the transcript if present; sized honestly if thin. Quotes only from retrieved text.

questions.q: who spoke about AI at the summit?
questions.expect: Damon Sununtnasuk (7 AI Workflows) at minimum; speakers named from catalog data, not guessed.

questions.q: who covered tiktok?
questions.expect: TikTok or Die trio + Tamar Yaniv, from the current Summit; older TikTok videos only as a one-line offer.

questions.q: show me the town hall video
questions.expect: Intro Presentation + Town Hall + Trend Report resolved by partial name, link, one-line what it is.

questions.q: the reddit session — who ran it and whats it about?
questions.expect: Jared Mortensen, Scaling a Subreddit as a Launch & AEO Asset, content from summary/transcript.

questions.q: is the leadership session worth watching?
questions.expect: A real recommendation grounded in its content and the asker's profile — never a dodge, never 'I cannot judge'. States what it covers so the member can decide.

questions.q: im short on time — which single summit session has the highest roi for an amazon seller?
questions.expect: One pick with grounded reasoning (Ivan Ong AMA or Run-Amazon-adjacent), from content actually held.

questions.q: any sessions about seo or organic traffic?
questions.expect: Subreddit/AEO session surfaces via subject search; if nothing else matches, says so plainly rather than padding with older events.

questions.q: videos on hiring or team building from the summit?
questions.expect: Leadership Layer if it matches; if the Summit has none on the subject, SAY the current event has none, then offer the back catalog (#151 order).

questions.q: what are the most relevant takeaways from the summit for me?
questions.expect: CONTENT from transcripts/summaries tailored to the asker — never a schedule, never session titles as takeaways, never 'the summit is over' unless is_over is true (#149). Venue block absent.

questions.q: summarize the ivan ong ama in 3 bullets
questions.expect: 3 bullets from the actual transcript/summary + link. Length honored. Bonus pass: each bullet cites the moment (timestamp) it came from.

questions.q: pull a quote from the tiktok or die session about getting started
questions.expect: Verbatim text from retrieved transcript chunks, quoted with the video TIMESTAMP (chunks carry start_sec/timestamp meta) and the video link. Attribution at session level (speakers are diarized A/B, not name-matched — #103); never invent who said it, never invent a quote.

questions.q: what did tamar yaniv say at the summit?
questions.expect: Exists-only: title, speaker, link, 'access is restricted to Summit attendees'. No content, no summary. The refusal names the real gate (#140/#150).

questions.q: do you have summit videos?
questions.expect: Yes + count + links (existence is not gated), content withheld with the reason. Never a false capability denial.

questions.q: where in the tamar video does she talk about sampling? give me the timestamp
questions.expect: The timestamp(s) of the sampling passage from chunk meta (e.g. 'around 12:40'), quote or close paraphrase, video link. Never a guessed time.

questions.q: quote exactly what was said about median member revenue in the town hall
questions.expect: Exact figure ($7M median) quoted verbatim from the transcript with timestamp + link; if the wording differs from memory, the TRANSCRIPT wins.

questions.q: give me ivan ong's best line from the ama, word for word, with where it is in the video
questions.expect: A real verbatim line + timestamp + link. 'Best' may be judged, the WORDS may not - retrieved text only, session-level attribution.
